name: Polar
line: Developer billing and merchant of record for digital products.

fee.math: This is for a US-issued card. The Pro plan (3.8% plus $0.40) costs $20 a month more.
UK sellers are supported, but the published card rate is for US-issued cards. No UK card rate is listed.
